settingsConfig.maxDifferenceBetweenSynchronizedAndInter: Max difference between synchronized and Internet time (milliseconds)
settingsConfig.maxDifferenceBetweenSynchronizedAndLocal: Max difference between synchronized and local time (milliseconds)
settingsConfig.statisticsAllowed: Send anonymous usage statistics and crash reports
settingsConfig.osTimeChangeCheckPeriodMs: İşletim sistemi zaman değişikliği kontrol süresi
settingsConfig.syncTimeExchangePeriod: Sync time synchronization interval for network requests
settingsConfig.syncTimeEpsilon: Sync time epsilon. New value is not applied if time delta less than epsilon
settingsConfig.maxVirtualCameraArchiveSynchronizationTh: Max virtual camera archive sync threads
settingsConfig.maxHttpTranscodingSessions: Max amount of HTTP connections using transcoding for the server. Chrome opens 2 connections at once, then close the first one. So, it is recommended to set value >=2 to this parameter.
settingsConfig.maxEventLogRecords: Maximum event log records to keep into the database. Real amount of undeleted records may be up to 20% higher than the specified value.
settingsConfig.forceLiveCacheForPrimaryStream: Whether to cache some frames for the primary stream. Values: "yes" - always enabled (may use a lot of RAM), "no" - always disabled except when required by the playback (e.g. HLS), "auto" - similar to "no", but turned on when improves the user experience (e.g. when some Analytics plugin is working on the camera).
